title: v1_42 / Browser support
content:
## Browser support

### Drag and drop files into the editor

When using VS Code in a browser, you can now drop local files into the editor area to open them as dirty (unsaved) files with the contents of the files.

<video src="images/1_42/web-dnd.mp4" title="Video showing In-browser support for drag and drop." autoplay loop controls muted></video>
